name: Last Trick ~Saigo no Sakuryaku~
source:
Main character lost belief in God together with his mother's death. At the same time a new person appeared in his life - Sphere. He calls himself a God who only needs a final license. He urges protagonist to make a wish. As incidents start to happen around protagonist, Sphere only laughs casually. What's left to protagonist. Only pray and make a wish. And his wish is...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-march-2004-remember11-age.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
母亲去世后，主角也失去了对神的信仰。与此同时，一个名为斯菲尔的新人物出现在他的生活中。他自称只差最后一张许可就能成为神，并催促主角许愿。主角身边开始发生各种事件时，斯菲尔只是漫不经心地笑着。主角还剩下什么？只能祈祷并许愿。而他的愿望是……

[来源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-march-2004-remember11-age.html]vndbreview[/url]]
